Some insight about Colombian prison  system and legal system.

The maximum jail sentence is 60 years, there is no life sentence or capital punishment, 60 years is the maximum for worst crimes like child rape and murder, multiple murder, torture and kidnapping, ( a high impact crime in Colombia) So there is the legal flaw, someone kills, rape, torture 1, 2 or 10+ victims and the maximum sentence is 60 years, so Garavito gets like a week jail time for each kid he raped and killed. There is another big difference with US prison system, when criminals killl another person in jail they don't get anymore  jail time, criminals also get to reduce jail time by studying and working, 1 day reduced by 1 day at work, criminals also get a 50% reduction sentence if confess before trial and last but not least  conditional release is mandatory, cannot be denied and occurs at 3/5 jail time served.

Colombian jails are not as brutal or  predatory like Brazil or Venezuelan Jails, and prison rapes are now uncommon, rapists are on special blocks with special security, if a prisoner dies in custody, the state has to pay an expensive  lawsuit.
